title: Discovery marks the first detection of variable water clouds outside of the solar system
caption:
Astronomers just used the James Webb Space Telescope to observe weather patterns on WISE 0855, a cold brown dwarf 7.5 light-years away. For the first time, we can see water clouds shifting and deep gases churning in real-time on a world outside our solar system.

Source: Phys - Discovery marks the first detection of variable water clouds outside of the solar system

https://phys.org/news/2026-10-discovery-variable-clouds-solar.html
